items.html: The second phase, which is lesser than it, remained in Adam HaRishon even after he sinned, and the Klipot did not rule over this one either. And it is called the Challah of the world, as mentioned. And it is the aspect of the light called Nefesh, within the Ketarim of each and every Sefira of the ten Sefirot, in each and every Partzuf of the ten aforementioned Partzufim. And these two phases — the first and the second — were not, before the sin, anything but a single phase, being the Ketarim in their completeness; and after he sinned, they divided into two phases.
